## [1.9.1](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/compare/v1.9.0...v1.9.1) (2026-11-12)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* target Compose approval cards and notification tap intents ([56df86f](https://github.com/srinath1848/nobrokerhood-patches/commit/56df86ff1276b785977f03258620ca8f76cf3f0a))

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Default browser, block known ad hosts (experimental)
patches.description: Keep default-browser support but block known Multipl and Innovid ad-tracking hosts.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide expanded notification images (experimental)
patches.description: Hide large banner images in entry/exit notifications while retaining text (3.6.11).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide floating promotional sidebar
patches.description: Hide the SideAd.kt Compose renderer attached to the RIGHT_AD home section.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide homepage billboard
patches.description: Clear both top-billboard state and app-bar banner state to hide rotating top ads.

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide post-approval sponsored media
patches.description: Suppress the Compose PacCard image/video renderer while retaining the approval screen (experimental).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Hide visitor promotional island
patches.description: Suppress AppBarIsland single-card and horizontal promotional rendering (experimental).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Sanitize entry/exit notification ad links
patches.description: Remove promotional URL extras when building entry/exit notification tap intents (experimental).

patches.name: NoBrokerHood: Stop full-screen permission nag
patches.description: Stop the home-screen full-screen alert reminder without changing permissions.
